rows.why: The prompts, pasted text and files sent to each model are traced to where they go, including external providers and the log stores that keep them.
Provider terms and contracts are reviewed for whether the provider keeps, reuses or trains on the prompts and files the organisation sends.
People who send prompts and files to the model are trained on what data may and may not be entered and into which approved tools.
Prompts, uploaded files and prompt logs are examined in use for personal or sensitive data being sent to the model or exposed through the logs.
Prompts and responses are logged with who sent them and when, and the logs are kept and reviewed so use of the model can be traced.

Sensitive input is classified, minimised or redacted before it reaches the model, blocked from unapproved AI services, encrypted, and prompt logs have restricted access, set retention and secure disposal.
Provider-side settings for retention and reuse of submitted prompts and files are applied and regularly checked, with provider telemetry monitored.
Leaks of sensitive data through prompts, files or prompt logs are reported, responded to with the provider where needed, recorded and reviewed.
